title: Explain it, then swap
summary: A free 12-minute paired speaking activity for school groups. Explain one idea, listen for a useful detail, swap roles and try a clearer version.
introduction: One idea. Two turns. A listener who can tell you what came through.
setting: In pairs, with a teacher or facilitator
materials: One familiar topic; notes are optional

steps.title: Choose an idea together
steps.detail: The teacher names a familiar, age-appropriate topic: a game rule, a classroom routine or an idea from today’s lesson. Model a short explanation. Partners choose something they can explain without sharing private experiences.

steps.title: Plan one point and one example
steps.detail: Each partner picks one point they want the other person to understand. Think of an everyday example. Use a few notes or practise quietly first. The teacher can simplify the prompt or offer another way to participate.

steps.title: Speak, listen, then swap
steps.detail: Partner A explains for about 30 seconds. Partner B names one detail they understood and asks one useful question. Swap roles so both partners get a speaking and listening turn. Leave a little thinking time before each answer.

steps.title: Try one clearer version
steps.detail: Each partner chooses one small change from the question they heard: state the main point sooner, use a clearer example or pause before an important detail. Give the explanation again. The listener says what became easier to follow.

steps.title: Choose a next step
steps.detail: Each partner names one speaking choice they want to keep. If they wish, pairs can share that choice with the group. The teacher closes with a concrete observation about listening or explanation, without ranking speakers.

prompts: Which part would you like me to explain again?
listenerGuide: Listen to the whole attempt before responding. Name a detail you heard, then ask a question about the idea. Describe the explanation rather than judging the person. In a pair, the listener also asks the question.
feedbackExample: I understood the first game rule. Could you show me what happens on the next turn?
editorialNote: Original illustrative V07 paired explanation activity.
